name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clause `Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled)` hard correctly captures 'Whenever the siren rings, turn it off' (every time `siren_ringing` is true until `switch_toggled` happens). The machine topology matches: state u0 pending response, transition on ringing to u1 (reward -1 for failure), transition on toggling back to u0 (reward +1 for success), and no final state as the task is rule-only. No added requirements or omissions.
